title: It looks good
text:
It looks good. You will love this if you enjoy the sensation of slipping off the chair all day. I am really unhappy with this chair and my husband has tried everything to adjust it but to no avail.
I hate it and I hate having to sit and work in it any longer...out it goes.

product_metadata.title: Sytas Office Chair Ergonomic Desk Chair Computer Task Mesh Chair with Flip-up Arms Lumbar Support and Adjustable Height, White
features: 【Simple & Elegant Design】This desk chair design is sleek and simple. It is an adjustment mid-back desk chair. This home office chair is a perfect match to any space: livingroom, study room, conference room and office. No matter in any occasions, it will make your room eye-catching.

【Extra Comfort】Ergonomic backrest fit the natural curve of the lower back and take the pain of spinal away from your body. Adjustable lumbar support can adapt to different groups of people. High density mesh back, flexible supportive, breathable. Thick padded seat cushion provides all day comfort.

【Space Saving】The home office chair comes with 90° adjustable armrests which can be flipped up or down. This office chair can fit nicely under the desk and save space; or provide comfort when you feel like to rest your arms.

【Height Adjustable】Sytas adjustable desks chair for home office has a 120° rocking style, you can control it by adjusting the tension knob and adjustable rod at the bottom of the cushion. Pneumatic height adjustable from 18.11 inch to 21.06 inch, match different stature. Weight capacity: 250lb.

【Stable & Durable】High bearing capacity base with smooth and silenced rolling wheels, max capacity 250lbs. Can also be used in the bedroom. Our team will provide you with high-quality after-sales service, if you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
